blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Can large language models (LLMs) advance theoretical computer science and resolve its long-standing open conjectures? To study progress toward this goal, we introduce TCSExam, a unified framework and benchmark covering the full range of TCS research. It evaluates theorem proving, solver engineering, and constructions alongside direct attempts to resolve open conjectures, capturing both concrete research accomplishments and progress toward long-standing research goals. TCSExam-Full contains 100 expert-reviewed tasks, with submissions checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. TCSExam-Lite selects 20 tasks, five per track, reducing the number of task attempts by 80% at the same per-attempt budget. We evaluate eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. The TCSExam Index combines all four tracks: GPT-6 Astra leads Full (71.9), and Opus 5.5 leads Lite (72.3). Full and Lite rankings are strongly aligned across eight shared agents (Spearman's $ρ=0.93$), supporting Lite as a compact, discriminative benchmark. The evaluations yield improved solver outputs and mathematical constructions, together with independently verified special cases and bounds from open-conjecture attempts. TCSExam provides an extensible framework with task sources, Docker build recipes, and evaluation tools for reproducible use.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLM)能否推进理论计算机科学,解决其长期存在的开放猜想? 为了研究实现这一目标的进展情况,我们采用了TCSExam,这是一个涵盖全部TCS研究的统一框架和基准。 它在直接尝试解决公开猜想的同时,评价理论的证明、解析器工程和建筑,同时掌握具体研究成就和实现长期研究目标的进展。 TCSExam-Full包含100项经专家审查的任务,提交材料由Lean内核或可执行的任务检查器检查. TCSExam-Lite选择了20项任务,每道5项,任务尝试次数减少80%,每道3项任务的预算相同. 我们评估8名特工在全线 9名特工在Lite线上 TCSExam指数将所有四个音轨结合起来:GPT-6 Astra lead Full (71.9),Opus 5.5 lead Lite (72.3). 完全和Lite的排名在8个共享代理商(Spearman's $ 0.93$)之间非常一致,支持Lite作为一个紧凑,歧视性的基准. 这些评价提高了解析器产出和数学构造,以及独立核实的特殊情况和开放猜想的界限。 TCSExam提供了一个具有任务源的可扩展框架,Docker构建食谱,以及可复制使用的评价工具.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Can large language models (LLMs) resolve long-standing open conjectures and advance theoretical computer science? Studying progress toward this ambition poses a challenge for evaluation: when a conjecture remains unresolved, the final outcome alone reveals little about which research tasks an LLM can perform or where its limitations lie. An informative evaluation should therefore examine concrete research accomplishments alongside direct attempts to prove or refute open conjectures.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)能解决长期存在的开放猜想并推进理论计算机科学吗? 研究在实现这一雄心壮志方面的进展对评价提出了挑战:当猜想仍未解决时,仅最后结果本身就很少揭示出一个LLM能够完成哪些研究任务,或者其局限性在哪里。 因此,在直接尝试证明或反驳公开的猜想的同时,应审查具体的研究成就。

blocks.en: Three forms of research output provide concrete ways to examine these questions. Theorem proving requires complete arguments for research-level mathematical statements. Solver engineering produces reusable programs whose effectiveness is tested across problem instances. Constructions provide explicit mathematical objects with verified properties that establish or improve bounds. Each output has independent research value, and the methods used to obtain them can interact: solvers search for candidate objects, proofs establish their properties, and constructions can supply witnesses or counterexamples. Evaluating these outputs helps TCS researchers judge which research work LLMs can undertake and helps model developers identify priorities for improvement.
blocks.zh: 三种形式的研究成果为审查这些问题提供了具体的方法。 理论的证明要求研究层面的数学声明有完整的论证. Solver 工程生产可重复使用的程序,其有效性通过问题实例测试. 构件提供具有可验证属性的明确数学对象,可以确定或改进界限. 每个输出都具有独立的研究价值,获取它们的方法可以相互作用:解决者寻找候选对象,证明确定其属性,构造可以提供证人或反例. 评估这些产出有助于技合系统研究人员判断哪些研究工作可以进行,并有助于模型开发者确定需要改进的优先事项。

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks address selected aspects of TCS research (Table 1 ). We introduce TCSExam , a unified framework and benchmark covering the full range of TCS research (Figure 1 ). Its four tracks evaluate theorem proving, solver engineering, constructions, and open-conjecture settlement, with success criteria defined by the requested outputs. Research areas can span multiple tracks, and shared task interfaces and verification protocols support the incorporation of additional problems.
blocks.zh: 现有基准涉及技合研究的某些方面(表1)。 我们引入了TCSExam(TCSExam),这是一个涵盖全部TCS研究的统一框架和基准(图一.). 它的四个轨道评价了定理的证明,解析器工程,施工,以及开口猜想结算,成功标准由请求的产出确定. 研究领域可以跨越多条轨道,共享任务界面和核查协议支持纳入额外的问题.

Arrows show how proving, searching, and constructing can contribute to one another and to resolving open conjectures. The examples illustrate tasks within each track; research areas can span multiple tracks.

blocks.en:
TCSExam comprises 100 tasks: 20 research theorems to prove in Lean 4 ( de Moura & Ullrich, 2021 ) , 30 solver-engineering problems evaluated over instance families, 20 construction problems scored against documented records, and 30 open conjectures in prove-or-refute form. Authors with expertise in the relevant TCS areas reviewed all 100 tasks for research significance. Every submission is checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. This combines expert judgment about which problems matter with reproducible verification of the submitted results.
For smaller-scale evaluations, TCSExam-Lite provides a 20-task subset with five tasks per track, selected to cover diverse topics and performance profiles within the Full suite.

三角洲 考试包括100个任务:20个研究定理在Lean 4(de Moura & Ullrich, 2021年)中证明,30个解题工程问题被评价为个案家庭,20个建筑问题被记录得分,30个公开猜想以证明或重复的形式证明。 具有技术合作战略相关领域专门知识的作者审查了所有100项研究任务。 每次提交都由精益内核或可执行的任务检查器检查. 这把专家的判断与对所提交结果的可复制核查结合起来。
对于规模较小的评价,TCSExam-Lite提供了一个20个任务子集,每个音轨有5个任务,被选中来涵盖全集内的各种主题和性能简介.

blocks.en: We evaluate eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. On 20 research theorems without supplied intermediate lemmas, GPT-6 Astra achieves a per-attempt complete-proof success rate of 70.0%, followed by Kimi K3.1 Pro at 38.3%; the other six agents achieve at most 11.7%. Solver performance varies across instance families, with submitted programs improving on public competition circuits. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 produces a verified construction that exceeds a task reference despite completing none of its 60 theorem-proving attempts. Individual attempts also yield independently verified special cases and bounds (Section 5.6 ).

blocks.en: Lite extends the comparison to Opus 5.5, which solves four of its five theorem tasks, compared with three for Astra. Full and Lite rankings agree on 26 of 28 pairs among the eight shared agents, while track-level comparisons reveal differences in their research capabilities (Section 5.3 ).

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • A framework spanning the full range of TCS research. Four tracks evaluate research outputs and open-conjecture settlement through shared task interfaces, distinct success criteria, and a common protocol for incorporating additional problems. • An expert-reviewed benchmark with verifiable outcomes. We curate 100 research tasks and a 20-task Lite subset with track-specific scoring and verification by the Lean kernel or executable task checkers. • A systematic evaluation of nine agents across Full and Lite. We characterize performance across the four tracks and examine submitted proofs, programs, and constructions to identify research accomplishments and remaining limitations.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Theorem proving in mathematics and TCS. TCS-BENCH ( Cohen-Addad et al., 2026 ) evaluates research-level natural-language proofs using an LLM verifier. Despite reported accuracy above 90% against expert judgments, acceptance remains subject to verifier errors and provides no formal correctness guarantee. FormalTCS ( Wang et al., 2026 ) evaluates end-to-end formalization and proving of TCS results. Their benchmark scope does not include reusable solver performance or construction quality. Formal evaluation also spans competition mathematics, undergraduate mathematics, and repository-context proofs ( Zheng et al., 2021 ; Tsoukalas et al., 2024 ; Azerbayev et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) . CombiBench provides formal combinatorial problems in Lean 4 ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , while LeanGeo-Bench evaluates competition geometry in the LeanGeo framework ( Song et al., 2025 ) . Kimina-Prover uses reinforcement learning to train structured reasoning for Lean 4 proof generation ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Proof guidance and decomposition are studied by Draft, Sketch, and Prove, DeepSeek-Prover-V2, and Seed-Prover ( Jiang et al., 2022 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在数学和TCS中验证定理. TCS-BENCH(Cohen-Addad等,2026年)使用LLM验证器评价研究层面的自然语言证明. 尽管专家判断报告准确度超过90%,但接受仍有核实错误,没有正式的正确性保障。 FormalTCS(Wang等,2026年)评价端到端形式化,并证明TCS结果. 其基准范围不包括可再利用的解决方案性能或施工质量. 正式评价还跨越了竞赛数学,本科数学,和寄存器-文本证明(郑等,2021;特苏克拉斯等,2024;阿泽尔巴耶夫等,2023;杨等,2023;胡等,2024). Combi Bench在Lean 4(Liu等,2025年)中提供正式的组合问题,而LeanGeo-Bench则在LeanGeo框架中评价竞争几何(Song等,2025年). Kimina-Prover使用加固学习来为Lean 4验证生成培养结构化推理(Wang等,2025). 由Draft,Sketch,和Prove,DeepSeek-Prover-V2和Seed-Prover(Jiang等,2022;Ren等,2025;Chen等,2025)研究指导与分解.

blocks.en: Solver programs and explicit constructions. AlphaTensor and AlphaDev demonstrate algorithm discovery through reinforcement learning ( Fawzi et al., 2022 ; Mankowitz et al., 2023 ) ; FunSearch and AlphaEvolve use program search for mathematical and computational improvements ( Romera-Paredes et al., 2024 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) . FrontierCS evaluates executable programs on open-ended algorithmic and research tasks ( Mang et al., 2026b ; Frontier-CS Team, 2026 ) . FrontierCS 2 compares agents’ reimplementations of research contributions with the original code across 48 public tasks ( Mang et al., 2026a ) . EdgeBench includes formal proving and combinatorial optimization in long-interaction evaluation ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . TCSExam separately evaluates reusable solvers across instance families and the parameters attained by explicit constructions.

blocks.en: Open conjectures and research-level evaluation. FrontierMath evaluates advanced mathematical reasoning through automatically checkable answers ( Glazer et al., 2024 ) . Formal Conjectures supplies formalized research problems and frozen evaluations of verified discovery ( Firsching et al., 2026 ) ; the proving-ground repository reports complete solutions and verified reductions on its open tier ( phyter1, 2026 ) . TCSExam evaluates complete proof or refutation of open TCS conjectures, retaining intermediate outputs for separate analysis.

TCSExam brings four forms of TCS research output into one extensible framework, with distinct success criteria and common procedures for task development, verification, and version control.

blocks.en: TCSExam organizes tasks across TCS areas by their required outputs and success criteria into the four tracks in Figure 1 . Search can produce candidate objects, proofs establish their properties, and both can contribute to resolving open conjectures. Appendix A lists the 100 tasks and their sources.

blocks.en: 3.1 Research scope and task interfaces
blocks.zh: 3.1 研究范围和任务接口

blocks.en: Theorem proving (20 tasks). Given a formal statement derived from a research theorem, the model submits a Lean 4 proof. We vary the supplied context through three settings with a common target: bare provides the main statement, fixed definitions, and mathematical assumptions; ladder additionally provides intermediate lemma statements; guided further supplies proof ideas. This design is related to TCS-BENCH’s use of intermediate-result masking to vary proof-task difficulty ( Cohen-Addad et al., 2026 ) . Our main evaluation uses bare to measure complete-proof success. Ladder and guided support a separate analysis of proof guidance, with partial checkpoint credit and independent complete-proof checks (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 论证定理(20项任务). 鉴于从研究定理中得出的正式声明,模型提交了"精益四证". 我们通过三个设置来改变所提供的上下文,有一个共同的目标:赤裸提供主语句,固定定义,和数学假设;阶梯额外提供中间lemma语句;引导进一步提供证明思想. 这种设计与TCS-BENCH使用中间结果口罩来改变证明任务难度有关(Cohen-Addad等,2026年). 我们的主要评价是赤裸裸的,用来衡量完全无懈可击的成功。 升降机和制导机支持对证明指导进行单独分析,提供部分检查站信贷和独立全防检查(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: Solver engineering (30 tasks). The model receives a problem specification, a naive baseline, and public instances, then submits a reusable solver program. Final judging evaluates the program across the task’s designated instance set under task-specific resource limits. Checkers validate solutions or certificates and recompute objective values.
blocks.zh: 溶解工程(30项任务). 该模型收到一个问题规格,一个天真的基准,以及公共实例,然后提交一个可重复使用的解决程序. 最后判断方案在任务特定资源限度下对任务指定实例进行评价。 检查器验证解决方案或证书并重算客观值.

blocks.en: Constructions (20 tasks). The model submits an explicit mathematical object and a certificate of its required properties. Examples include codes, geometric configurations, and graph colorings. Tasks use Lean 4 formalizations and executable checks to verify the object and its achieved parameter. Documented construction records provide reference values against which progress is measured; the model may use mathematical reasoning, search code, or both to produce its submission.
blocks.zh: 建设 (20个任务). 该模型提交一个明确的数学对象并出具其所需属性的证书. 例子包括代码,几何配置,和图色. 任务使用Lean 4正规化和可执行检查来验证对象及其已实现的参数. 所记录的构造记录提供了用来衡量进度的参考值;该模型可能使用数学推理,搜索代码,或两者并用来生成其提交.

blocks.en: Open conjectures (30 tasks). The model receives a formalized conjecture and two Lean proof slots, conj and refuted , for the statement and its negation. A submission must prove either side in full. A counterexample must come with a proof that it refutes the stated conjecture. This interface accepts either direction of a resolution.
blocks.zh: 开口猜想(30项任务). 该模型收到一个正式的猜想和两个精益求精的证明插槽,用于陈述及其否定。 呈文必须充分证明任何一方。 反例必须提出证据,证明它驳斥了所说的猜想. 此接口接受分辨率的任意方向 。

blocks.en: 3.2 Task curation and development
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 任务管理和发展

blocks.en: We select tasks for their research significance , coverage across TCS areas , and verifiable outcomes . Theorem tasks come from recent TCS papers (2023–2026) and span 13 subfields. Solver tasks draw on established competitions and instance libraries. Task-specific safeguards, including withholding hidden instances from the agent during development and applying structure-preserving transformations, mitigate direct reuse of stored answers. Construction tasks target open problems with documented records, while the open-conjecture track includes problems such as log-rank and Ryser. Expert review assesses the significance and representativeness of the selected problems.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了具有研究意义的任务,涵盖技合领域,以及可核实的结果。 定理任务出自最近的TCS论文(2023–2026)并跨出13个子领域. 解决的任务借鉴了既有的竞争和实例库. 针对特定任务的保障措施,包括在开发过程中从剂中预留隐藏实例,并应用结构保存转换,可减轻被存储答案的直接再利用. 建筑任务针对的是有文件记载的开口问题,而开口猜想道则包括了log-rank和Ryser等问题. 专家审评评估选定问题的重要性和代表性。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Task curation and validation. Expert selection is followed by agent-assisted authoring and review, executable checks, and trial evaluation. Statement mismatches, scorer errors, and unexpected results prompt revision and re-testing. Tasks are included after expert approval; exceptional results trigger verification and source re-checks.
blocks.zh: 图 2:任务整理与论证. 专家甄选之后是代理人协助撰写和审查、可执行检查和审判评价。 语句不匹配,计分器出错,以及出乎意料的结果会迅速修改并重新测试. 任务在专家批准后列入;例外结果触发核查和来源再核查。

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes the task development process. An authoring agent prepares the statement, submission interface, scorer, and environment. A separate review agent checks correspondence to the research source and the behavior of the verification procedure. Tests and pilot evaluations identify defects and guide revision. Across development rounds, over 40 theorem problems were retired after being solved in pilot evaluations. Tasks are included after expert approval.
blocks.zh: 图2概述了任务拟订过程。 作者代理编写语句,提交界面,计分器,以及环境. 单独的审查代理人检查与研究来源的通信以及核查程序的行为。 测试和试点评价发现缺陷并指导修订工作. 在整个开发回合中,40多个定理问题在试点评价中被解决后被退役. 任务经专家批准后列入.

blocks.en: 3.3 Track-specific scoring
blocks.zh: 3.3 田径专用分数

blocks.en: Scores reflect the submitted output and the task’s notion of success. Complete proof obligations use binary scores; optimization and construction tasks provide graded credit. The score definitions and integrity checks are specified per track (Appendix B ). Reported scores use percentages rounded to one decimal; formulas use the original score units.
blocks.zh: 得分反映提交的产出和任务的成功概念。 完整的证明义务使用二进制分数;优化和施工任务提供分级信用. 分数定义和完整性检查由每个音轨指定(附录B. 所报分数使用四舍五入至一小数的百分比;公式使用原始分数单位.

blocks.en: Theorem proving. A valid proof of the complete bare-level statement scores 100.0%; an incomplete proof scores 0.0%. Guided and ladder tasks receive partial credit for the fraction of checkpoints passed; a verified complete proof receives full credit. Each checkpoint is checked in isolation with the other checkpoint statements supplied as assumptions; this also applies to the main-theorem checkpoint. Coverage therefore measures conditional proof obligations. Complete proofs are checked separately without unproved checkpoint assumptions (Appendix B.1 ).
blocks.zh: 定理证明. 完整光级报表的有效证明得分为100.0%;不完整证明得分为0.00%. 所经过的检查站有一部分被引导和梯级任务获得部分信贷;经核实的完整证据获得全额信贷。 每个检查站都与作为假设提供的其他检查站报表隔离检查;这也适用于主定理检查站。 因此,涵盖范围衡量有条件的举证义务。 完整的证明单独检查,没有未经证明的检查站假设(附录B.1.

blocks.en: Solver engineering. Optimization tasks measure the fraction of the difference between a naive baseline B B and a task reference K K recovered by the submitted solver. These scores are not clipped: values below 0.0% indicate performance worse than the baseline, and values above 100.0% indicate improvement over the reference. Decision tasks use solve rates. A separate Kimi K3-relative score standardizes raw instance outcomes against repeated Kimi K3 runs and applies a Gaussian cumulative-distribution transform (Appendix B.2 ). Scores are averaged over instances, then attempts within tasks, then tasks. Improvements over K K undergo artifact and source verification before being described as new records.
blocks.zh: 溶解工程. 优化任务测量一个天真基准B和提交解析器所回收的任务参考K K的差分. 这些分数没有被剪接:低于0.0%的分数显示性能比基线差,高于100.0%的分数显示比参考值有所改善。 决策任务使用解析率. 一个单独的Kimi K3相对分将原始实例结果与重复的Kimi K3运行相比标准化,并应用了高斯累积分流变换(Appendix B.2. 得分平均为个案,然后在任务范围内尝试,然后是任务。 对K K的改进经过文物和源头的核实,然后被描述为新的记录。

blocks.en: Constructions. Scores measure attainment relative to a trivial construction and a documented record: matching the record scores 100.0%, and surpassing it can score above 100.0%. Task-specific shaping is cubic for 14 tasks and linear for the remainder. We report the achieved mathematical parameters alongside these scores, since the score transformation changes the numerical size of an improvement. A record provides a comparison point even when the optimum remains unknown.
blocks.zh: 建筑学. 分数衡量成就相对于一个微不足道的构造和记录:匹配记录的分数为100.0%,超过记录的分数可超过100.0%。 任务特定塑造可立方进行14项任务,其余为线性. 我们报告已实现的数学参数和这些分数,因为分数转换改变了一个改进的数字大小。 记录提供了一个比较点,即使最佳记录仍然不明。

blocks.en: Open conjectures. A verified proof of either the statement or its negation scores 100.0%. All other submissions score 0.0% on the resolution criterion. We also analyze intermediate bounds, special cases, and counterexamples to related statements alongside the resolution score.
blocks.zh: 开放猜想. 经核实的报表或其否定分数为100.0%。 所有其他提交材料的分辨率标准为0.00%。 我们还分析中间界限、特例和与决议分数相关的声明的反例。

blocks.en: TCSExam Index. Let P P , S S , C C , and O O be the mean theorem, Solver, construction, and open-conjecture scores, respectively, on their original scales. The Solver input S S is the relative score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . We define I = 30 ​ P + 30 ​ S + 30 ​ C + 10 ​ O . I=30P+30S+30C+10O. (1) The three tracks with graded observed performance receive equal weight; open-conjecture resolution contributes the remaining ten points. These weights are the same for Full and Lite. Construction scores above 1 remain unchanged, so the Index can exceed 100. We report the four track means alongside the Index to show which capabilities account for an aggregate difference.

blocks.en: Every selected task retains its original scoring function, and the five task means receive equal weight within each track. Lite uses the same 12-hour development budget per attempt: one attempt on each task has a maximum development allocation of 240 hours, compared with 1,200 hours for Full. Task execution can run in parallel, and final judging has its own resource budget. Both Solver protocols use public instances for development. Full provides a parallel self-test service; Lite runs self-tests in the development environment, simplifying deployment. Both use the same final judging rules. Section 4 details these protocols. Section 5.3 compares the observed rankings under the two suite protocols.
blocks.zh: 每个被选中的任务保留了原有的评分功能,这五个任务意味着在每个赛道内获得同等分量. 利特每次尝试使用相同的12小时开发预算:一次尝试每个任务的最高开发分配为240小时,而Full的开发分配为1200小时. 任务执行可以平行进行,最终判断有自己的资源预算. 两种解决方案协议都使用公共实例进行开发. Full提供平行自试服务;Lite在开发环境中运行自试,简化部署. 两者都使用相同的最终判断规则. 第4节详细规定了这些协议。 第5.3节比较了两个套房协议下观察到的排名.

blocks.en: 3.5 Task and result validation
blocks.zh: 3.5 任务和结果验证

blocks.en: Before a task enters the benchmark, task validation checks whether the encoded problem matches its research source. After submission, result validation checks outputs against the task rules, with additional review for candidate advances. Appendix C documents these checks and supporting evidence.
blocks.zh: 在任务进入基准之前,任务验证检查被编码的问题是否与其研究来源相匹配. 提交后,结果验证对照任务规则对产出进行核查,并对候选人的预付款进行额外审查。 附 录 C证明这些检查和佐证。

blocks.en: Formal statement fidelity. Agent-assisted reviews compare definitions, assumptions, quantifiers, and parameter ranges in the Lean statement with the source. Small examples and boundary cases test for degenerate or unintended interpretations, and re-translation provides an additional cross-check. Shared definitions and statements are checked across disclosure levels. Successful proofs and unexpected outcomes prompt renewed scrutiny of the statement and its assumptions. These checks also flagged potential inconsistencies in source statements or proofs; candidate tasks with unresolved concerns were excluded.
blocks.zh: 正式声明忠诚。 代理辅助审查将Lean语句中的定义,假设,限定词,和参数范围与源进行比较. 以小实例和边界案例为标准来检验不合理或无意的解释,再作再翻译,可进行额外的交叉核对。 共用的定义和报表在披露层面都得到检查。 成功的证明和出乎意料的结果促使人们重新审查该声明及其假设。 这些检查还揭示了来源说明或证明中可能存在的不一致之处;排除了未解决的候选任务。

blocks.en: Result validation. Every submission is checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. Candidate advances additionally undergo agent-assisted audits of the rollouts and submitted artifacts. These audits check compliance with task rules, proof dependencies or object validity, and the conditions of the claimed improvement. For solver results, this includes comparing instance sets and execution budgets. Source checks distinguish improvements over task references from new literature records; claims of new records require evidence for the prior best value and a matching problem setting.
blocks.zh: 成果验证. 每次提交都由精益内核或可执行的任务检查器检查. 此外,候选人还接受代理人协助的推广审计并提交了文物。 这些审计检查任务规则的遵守情况、证据依赖性或对象有效性以及所称改进的条件。 对于解决方案的结果,这包括比较实例集和执行预算。 原始资料核对将任务参考的改进与新的文献记录区分开来;对新记录的索赔要求提供先前最佳价值的证据,并设定相应的问题。

blocks.en: Task versions and extensions. Each reported result is associated with the task statement, environment, verifier, and reference values used in evaluation. Corrections and additional problems enter new task versions, with changes and affected results recorded. Earlier versions and evaluation records are retained so that results remain interpretable as the benchmark expands.
blocks.zh: 任务版本和扩展. 所报告的每项结果都与评价中使用的任务说明、环境、核查人和参考值有关。 更正和额外问题输入了新的任务版本,并记录了变化和影响的结果。 保留了以前的版本和评价记录,以便随着基准的扩大,成果仍然可以解释。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Agents and execution. Each evaluated agent combines an LLM with an execution harness that manages tool use and interaction with the environment. Full includes GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , Kimi K3 ( Kimi Team, 2026a ) , GLM-5.3 ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , Qwen3.8 Max (0902) ( Alibaba Cloud, 2026 ) , Grok 4.6 ( xAI, 2026 ) , DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , and Kimi K3.1 Pro ( Kimi Team, 2026b ) . Lite includes these eight agents and Opus 5.5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) . The configurations appear in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 特工与处决. 每个被评价的代理人将LLM与管理工具使用和与环境互动的执行控制器结合起来. 全部包括:GPT-6 Astra(OpenAI,2026a),Kimi K3(Kimi Team,2026a),GLM-5.3(Z.ai,2026),Qune3.8 Max(0902)(Alibaba Cloud,2026),Grok 4.6(xAI,2026),DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910和DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017(DeepSek-AI,2026),和Kimi K3.1 Pro(Kimi Team,2026b). 利特包括了这8名特务和Opus 5.5(Anthropic,2026. 这些配置载于附录D。

blocks.en: Tasks and resources. Full contains 20 bare-level theorems, 30 Solver problems, 20 constructions, and 30 open conjectures; Lite contains five tasks per track. Kimi K3, Kimi K3.1 Pro, and both DeepSeek versions contribute three attempts per task; the other agents contribute one. An attempt is one agent run on one task, with a 12-hour wall-clock development budget. Theorem and Solver development have no general Internet access. Construction and open-conjecture tasks permit literature access. Tasks use the Harbor format ( Harbor Framework Team, 2026 ) to package environments, submission interfaces, and verifiers. Construction prompts provide published reference bounds. Solver judging uses separate per-instance or shared-pool budgets (Appendix D.2 ).
blocks.zh: 任务和资源。 完整包含有20个光相定理,30个Solver问题,20个构造,30个开口猜想;Lite包含每道5个任务. Kimi K3,Kimi K3.1 Pro,两个DeepSeek版本都为每个任务贡献了三次尝试;其他代理都贡献了一次. 一项尝试是一名代理人执行一项任务,其发展预算为12小时。 定理和Solver开发没有一般的互联网接入. 建筑和开放推测任务允许文献访问. 任务使用港站格式(港站框架团队,2026年)来包装环境,提交界面,以及验证器. 建筑提示提供了已公布的参考界限. 解决办法使用单独的逐项预算或共用预算(附录D.2)。

blocks.en: Solver development protocols. Both protocols provide the same public instances and self-test information during development. Full uses Online: an external service evaluates submitted solvers, parallelizing independent instances to accelerate iteration. Lite uses Offline: agents run public self-tests in their development environment, with parallelism limited by its resources. This removes the need to deploy a parallel judging service. Both protocols reserve hidden-set judging for the final submission and retain the same input split, checker, final execution limits, and fixed Kimi K3 reference. Online and Offline describe how public self-tests run; task network policies are unchanged.
blocks.zh: 溶解开发协议. 这两项协议在开发过程中提供相同的公共实例和自我测试信息. 完全使用 Online:一个外部服务评价提交的解析器,并行独立实例来加速重迭. Lite使用offline:代理在其开发环境中进行公共自试,其资源限制了平行性. 这就不再需要部署一个平行的判断服务。 两个协议都为最终提交保留了隐藏设置,并保留了相同的输入分拆,检查器,最终执行限制,并固定了Kimi K3的引用. Online和Outline描述公众自我测试如何运行;任务网络政策不变.

blocks.en: Score aggregation and shared tasks. We first average attempts within each task, then average tasks equally within a track. Theorem success rates divide complete proofs by all scheduled attempts: 20 or 60 on Full, and 5 or 15 on Lite. The Index combines the four track means using Equation 1 . The 15 non-Solver tasks shared by Full and Lite reuse the same submissions for each of the eight common agents. Solver results come from separate evaluations under each suite’s development protocol. Opus contributes 20 Lite results. Appendix H.2 describes these result sets.
blocks.zh: 分数汇总和共享任务. 我们首先在每项任务中进行平均努力,然后在轨道中进行平均努力。 定理成功率通过所有预定的尝试将完整的证明除以:在Full上20或60分,在Lite上5或15分. 指数结合了四道道指用方程式一. Full和Lite共同承担的15个非溶剂任务对8个共同剂中的每个剂都重复使用相同的提交. 解决办法来自每个套房开发协议下的单独评价。 Opus贡献了20升的结果. 附录H.2说明了这些结果集。

blocks.en: Proof-guidance comparison. We compare Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 on the same 20 theorems, with three attempts per theorem in each setting. Bare supplies the target statement and definitions; ladder adds intermediate lemma statements; guided also supplies proof ideas. Complete-proof success requires a verified assembled or direct proof without unproved checkpoint assumptions. We report success per attempt and the number of theorems solved at least once; ladder and guided also receive partial checkpoint credit (Appendix D.3 ).
blocks.zh: 指导证明比较. 我们比较Kimi K3和DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910在相同的20个定理上,每个设定每个定理都有三次尝试. 赤裸提供目标语句和定义;阶梯会添加中间lemma语句;还指导提供证明思想. 完全防守成功需要经过核实的组装或直接证明,没有未经证明的检查站假设. 我们报告每次尝试都取得了成功,至少解决一次定理的数目;梯子和被引导者还获得部分检查站信贷(附录D.3)。

blocks.en: Research proofs distinguish the evaluated agents. GPT-6 Astra completes 14 of 20 theorems (70.0%) without supplied intermediate lemmas. Kimi K3.1 Pro succeeds in 23 of 60 attempts (38.3%), solving nine distinct theorems. It completes all three attempts on the PCP alphabet-soundness task, which Astra does not solve. blocks.en: Construction means reflect reference attainment across tasks. Astra has the highest mean at 104.9%, matching the reference on 17 tasks and exceeding it on three. The other agents range from 86.2% to 98.6%, with Kimi K3.1 Pro second. GLM-5.3 averages 97.7% without exceeding any reference, illustrating that broad reference attainment and individual improvements are distinct aspects of performance. Section 5.5 examines the verified improvements on specific tasks.
blocks.zh: 建设意味着在各项任务中实现参照标准。 Astra的中位数最高,为104.9%,与17项任务的参考数相匹配,超过3项。 其他制剂从86.2%到98.6%不等,Kimi K3.1 二号 GLM-5.3平均数 97.7%没有超过任何参考,说明广泛的参考成就和个人改进是业绩的不同方面。 第5.5节审查了经核实的具体任务的改进。

blocks.en: 5.2 Solver performance across instance families
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 解决个案家庭的业绩问题

blocks.en: Performance differs across problem families. On each instance, a relative score of 50.0% denotes a valid outcome equal to the Kimi K3 reference mean. Astra averages 64.7%, followed by Kimi K3.1 Pro at 54.1% and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 at 53.1%. The other five agents range from 43.8% to 49.2% (Table 2 ). Astra has the highest unrounded task mean, including ties, on 27 of 30 problems (Figure 3 b). It trails GLM-5.3 on hitting set, Kimi K3 on dominating set, and GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8 Max (0902), Kimi K3.1 Pro, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 marginally on crossing minimization. Appendix E.2 gives detailed results.

blocks.en: Verified special cases and bounds. While attempting the full conjecture, GPT-6 Astra proves the Alon–Jaeger–Tarsi conjecture over 𝔽 5 \mathbb{F}_{5} for every n ≤ 9 n\leq 9 : every invertible n × n n\times n matrix A A admits a vector x x such that x x and A ​ x Ax have no zero coordinates. The n = 9 n=9 case extends the dimensional ranges n ≤ 7 n\leq 7 of Yu (1999) and n ≤ 8 n\leq 8 reported in a recent preprint ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . The proof combines counting identities with an exact integer certificate to exclude a minimal counterexample (Figure 6 ). Independent Lean verification confirms the result using only standard axioms. Appendix F.3 gives the proof structure, formal verification, and its relation to prior work. Four further verified cases concern a six-variable Fourier entropy–influence bound, an exact high-rank Hilbert-matrix rigidity formula, an influence bound for quadratic polynomials, and finite-instance online-matching bounds (Appendix F.4 ). These five cases demonstrate that open-conjecture attempts can produce independently verifiable mathematical results. Analyzing their statements and proofs captures progress beyond the binary resolution score and identifies concrete results for further mathematical study.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: TCSExam provides a unified, extensible framework for evaluating agents across the full range of TCS research, connecting theorem proving, solver engineering, and explicit constructions with open-conjecture settlement. Full comprises 100 expert-reviewed tasks with outcomes checked by the Lean kernel or executable checkers. Lite retains all four tracks in 20 tasks, reducing the number of task attempts by 80% at the same per-attempt budget. Evaluations across nine agents reveal substantial differences in research capabilities, with strong Full–Lite rank agreement among the eight shared agents. Together, the suites support broad capability assessment and smaller-scale evaluation.
blocks.zh: TCSExam为评价TCS全方位研究的代理提供了统一,可扩展的框架,将定理验证,解析器工程,以及清晰的构造与开口猜想结算相连接. 全部包括100项经专家审查的任务,结果由精核或可执行检查器检查。 Lite在20个任务中保留了全部4个音轨,任务尝试次数减少80%,与每个任务的预算相同. 对9个代理人的评价显示,在研究能力方面存在着很大差异,8个共有代理人之间达成了强有力的全层排名协议。 这些套房共同支持广泛的能力评估和小规模评价。

blocks.en: The results show complementary strengths in proof completion, solver performance, and construction quality. Submitted programs and mathematical objects improve selected task references. For both agents in the proof-guidance study, supplying intermediate lemmas and proof ideas increases the number of theorems solved. Open-conjecture attempts also yield independently verified special cases and bounds, including Astra’s nine-dimensional Alon–Jaeger–Tarsi result over 𝔽 5 \mathbb{F}_{5} . These outputs help characterize the research work agents can undertake and identify directions for further progress. The accompanying task sources, Docker build recipes, and evaluation tools support reproducible use and extension. Researchers can add problems through the shared task interfaces and verification protocols, extending this foundation for evaluating agents and studying their contributions to TCS research.
blocks.zh: 结果显示了在证明完成,解析器性能,施工质量等方面的互补优势. 提交的程序和数学对象改进了选定的任务引用 。 对于在校正指导研究中的两种代理人来说,提供中间lemma和校正思想会增加解开定理的数量. 开放猜想尝试也会产生独立核实的特例和界限,包括Astra的九维Aron–Jaeger–Tarsi结果出自F 5\mathb{F}_{5}. 这些产出有助于确定研究工作代理人可以开展哪些工作并确定取得进一步进展的方向。 配套的任务源,多克构建食谱,评价工具支持再生使用和扩展. 研究人员可以通过共享任务界面和核查协议来增加问题,将这一基础扩展为评估剂,并研究他们对TCS研究的贡献.

blocks.en: Theorem proving: corners-quasipoly. The task concerns the quantitative bound for corner-free sets of Jaber et al. (2025) and provides formal definitions and a fixed target theorem. Bare attempts must prove the target from the supplied mathematical context. Ladder and guided attempts additionally receive intermediate statements; guided attempts receive a proof idea. A local checkpoint proof is evaluated under the other checkpoint statements, whereas the complete-proof check excludes unproved checkpoint assumptions. The fixed target declaration and supplied assumptions determine the statement whose complete proof is scored.

blocks.en: Solver engineering: maxcut-mqlib. A submitted program receives a weighted graph from the MQLib collection ( Dunning et al., 2018 ) and returns a vertex partition. The checker validates the partition and recomputes the total weight of edges crossing the cut. Final judging applies the same program across the designated instance family under the task’s resource limits. The evaluation measures the program's performance across the instance family. blocks.en: A task supplies a formal proposition P P and slots for P P and ¬ P \neg P . A valid proof in either direction earns 1; otherwise the complete-resolution score is 0. Each main slot is checked in isolation after removing its contradictory twin, without treating either unproved main statement as an assumption. Auxiliary statements may support the submitted proof only within the permitted verification context. Special cases, reductions, and counterexamples to related stronger statements are reported with their precise scope and do not change the binary target score.

blocks.en: C.1 From a research source to a task
blocks.zh: 页:1 从研究来源到任务

blocks.en: Agent-assisted source reviews identify the intended research claim, its quantifiers and parameter range, and the result or object accepted by the task. For formal statements, component reconciliation maps each source definition and assumption to the corresponding Lean declaration. Small examples and boundary cases check that definitions behave as intended. Re-translation provides an additional comparison between the source and its formalization. Some re-translation passes were performed by the authoring agent, while other reviews used a fresh context. Shared definitions and statements are checked across the three theorem-disclosure levels.
blocks.zh: 代理协助源审查确定预期的研究要求,其限定词和参数范围,以及任务接受的结果或对象. 对于正式的语句,组件调节将每个源定义和假设映射到相应的Lean声明. 小型实例和边界案例检查定义是否按照预期行事。 重新翻译提供了来源与其形式化的又一比较. 一些再翻译通行证由作者代理执行,而其他评论则使用了新的上下文. 共有的定义和声明将在三个定理 -- -- 披露层面进行核对。

blocks.en: Checker review exercises both valid and invalid submissions: empty outputs, malformed objects, incorrect objectives, incomplete certificates, and attempts to change fixed statements. Reference outputs are used where available. For open conjectures, development tests check the proof-or-refutation interface and its rejection of invalid submissions.
blocks.zh: 检查器审查同时进行有效与无效的提交:空输出,错误对象,目标不正确,证书不完整,以及试图更改固定报表. 如有参考产出,则予以使用。 对于开口猜想,开发测试会检查证明-或反驳接口,并拒绝无效的提交.

blocks.en: C.2 Review triggered by unexpected outcomes
blocks.zh: C.2 意外结果引发的审查

blocks.en: A full proof or a value beyond the reference triggers agent-assisted re-examination of the rollout, submitted artifact, and task statement. The review checks adherence to the task rules, the accepted proof’s assumptions or the object’s verified properties, and the scope of the claimed result. For numerical improvements, source comparison checks the prior reference, problem parameters, instance set, and resource conditions. Mathematical validity and literature novelty are documented separately. If a statement or checker changes, the corrected task receives a new version; results on different versions retain their original scope.
blocks.zh: 充分证明或超出参考范围的价值触发代理人协助对推出、提交的文物和任务说明进行再审查。 审查检查是否遵守了任务规则、所接受的证明的假设或对象经核实的属性以及声称的结果的范围。 关于数字改进,源比较检查先前的参考、问题参数、实例集和资源条件。 数学有效性和文学新意分别被记载. 如果一个语句或检查器发生变化,被更正的任务会收到一个新的版本;不同版本的结果保留其原始范围.

blocks.en: Development checks sometimes identified apparent missing boundary conditions, discrepancies between definitions and their use in proofs, or potential gaps in arguments. We treated these as concerns requiring source reconciliation, including checks for mistakes in our own formalization. Candidate tasks were excluded when such concerns could not be resolved. This source-reconciliation process informed task selection and formalization.
blocks.zh: 发展检查有时会发现明显缺失的边界条件、定义之间的差异及其在证据中的使用,或论点中的潜在空白。 我们把这些问题视为需要源头调节的问题,包括检查我们自己正规化过程中的错误。 如果这种关切无法解决,则不执行候选任务。 这一源调和过程为任务选择和形式化提供了依据.

blocks.en: C.3 Curation and evaluation population
blocks.zh: C.3 校准和评价人口

blocks.en: The theorem collection was screened through pilot evaluations, with over 40 theorem problems retired across development rounds. The evaluation records retain the screening model and configuration, candidate and included task lists, and reasons for retirement. Because pilot performance informed task selection, the collection is conditioned on the screening agent's outcomes, which can affect its comparison with other agents. Task additions and retirements are recorded without changing historical evaluation manifests.
blocks.zh: 通过试点评价筛选出定理集,各开发回合有40多个定理问题退休. 评价记录保留了筛选模式和配置、候选人和任务清单以及退休理由。 由于试点性能知情任务选择,收集工作以筛选代理的结果为条件,这可能影响其与其他代理的比较. 任务增加和退休记录不改变历史评价表。

blocks.en: The project repository ( https://github.com/MoonshotAI/TCSExam ) provides task statements, Full and Lite suite definitions, Dockerfiles, data recipes, judging code, and evaluation commands. Users build environments on a Linux Docker host and configure their model provider and harness. The 100 logical tasks are packaged as 70 Lean tasks and 60 Solver variants, with Online and Offline versions for each Solver problem.

blocks.en: D.1 Agents, versions, and budgets

blocks.en: The evaluation includes eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. Each attempt has a development budget of up to 12 hours. blocks.en: D.2 Solver task construction and execution
blocks.zh: D.2 联合国 任务构建和执行

blocks.en: The solver collection comprises 19 competition-derived tasks and 11 tasks based on instance libraries. Source type and execution budget are separate choices: either type can use per-instance limits or a shared time pool. Each task specifies a public development set, a final evaluation set, an executable submission interface, and a checker. Competition-derived tasks can retain the source’s development/test distinction or define a new split of released instances. Library-derived tasks define their own splits; these are fixed in the task version rather than selected from model outcomes. Table 10 records the evaluated configurations.
blocks.zh: 解决者收藏包括19项竞争衍生任务和11项基于实例库的任务。 来源类型和执行预算是不同的选择:任一类型都可以使用每类限制或共用时间池. 每个任务都指定了公共开发集,最终评价集,可执行的提交界面,以及检查器. 竞争产生的任务可以保留来源的开发/测试区别,或者确定新分割的释放实例。 由库衍生出的任务定义了自己的拆分;这些被固定在任务版本中,而不是从模型结果中选择. 表10记录了评估的配置。

blocks.en: Public instances and self-test results are available during program development. Hidden instance files and transformation parameters remain on the judging side, outside the agent’s development environment. Public development and final evaluation use disjoint sets of source instances.
blocks.zh: 公共实例和自我测试结果在程序开发期间提供。 隐藏实例文件和变换参数仍然处于判断的一面,不在代理人的发展环境之外。 公共发展和最后评价使用不相连的成套来源实例。

blocks.en: The quadratic-assignment task illustrates the conversion of a public library into a solver evaluation. From 136 QAPLIB instances ( Burkard et al., 1997 ) , the versioned split assigns 41 to hidden evaluation, 75 to public development, and 20 to neither set. Hidden selection is stratified by instance family and size; withholding the third group prevents the public complement from identifying the evaluation set exactly. Hidden instances independently permute facility and location indices. If π \pi relabels facilities and σ \sigma relabels locations, a feasible assignment p p becomes p ′ = σ ∘ p ∘ π − 1 p^{\prime}=\sigma\circ p\circ\pi^{-1} . Applying the same relabelings to the flow and distance matrices preserves every assignment’s cost and the optimal value. The checker validates the submitted permutation and recomputes its cost on the transformed instance.

blocks.en: Other transformations follow the problem’s structure, such as vertex relabeling for graph problems and item reordering for bin packing. These changes obstruct direct reuse of answers in the original indexing. Training exposure to the public source instances is unknown. The submission rules require computation during judging and prohibit replay of stored final answers; hidden access controls, transformations, and rollout audits support compliance at complementary stages.
blocks.zh: 其他的变换遵循了问题的结构,如为图题重新贴上顶点的标签和为取入的包装重新排列项目等. 这些变化阻碍在原始索引中直接再利用答案. 对公共来源的培训情况不详。 提交规则要求在判断和禁止重放存储的最后答案时进行计算;隐蔽访问控制、转换和推出审计支持在补充阶段遵守规定。

blocks.en: The 12-hour budget covers model interaction and program development. Afterward, the frozen program is rebuilt and evaluated under the task’s separate execution limits. Twenty-four tasks impose limits independently on each instance. Six tasks instead share one total time pool: bin packing, graph partitioning, sports timetabling, logic synthesis, quadratic assignment, and set cover. The judge processes the evaluation family while tracking the remaining pool, which is supplied to the program on each invocation. Time saved on one instance is available to later instances; these tasks are evaluated as one group to preserve this allocation rule. For example, quadratic assignment has 1,230 seconds across its 41 final instances, with no separate 30-second cutoff per instance. Glass cutting uses two runs per instance, at 180 and 3,600 seconds, with weights 0.1 and 0.9. Table 10 specifies each task’s final execution time budget.
blocks.zh: 12小时预算涵盖模式互动和计划开发. 之后,被冻结的程序在任务单独的执行限制下重建和评价. 24项任务分别对每个案例施加限制。 六个任务相反共用一个总时间池:bin包装,图分,运动计时,逻辑合成,四面派任务,以及设定封面. 法官在跟踪剩余人才库的同时处理评价家庭,每个引用都提供给方案。 以后的情况可以节省一次时间;这些任务被评为一组,以维持这一分配规则。 例如,在41个最后例子中,四分法任务有1 230秒,没有单独的30秒的间隔。 玻璃切割采用每例两次跑道,180和3600秒,重量为0.1和0.9. 表10列出了每项任务的最后执行时间预算。

blocks.en: For per-instance evaluation, we use up to ten isolated sandboxes concurrently, using ten whenever the number of instances and available resources permit. Each instance retains the specified time, CPU, and memory limits. Shared-pool tasks remain in one evaluation group to preserve cross-instance time allocation.
blocks.zh: 在每一次评估中,我们同时使用多达10个孤立的沙盒,只要案件数目和可用资源允许,就使用10个。 每个实例保留指定的时间,CPU,和内存限制. 共用资源的任务仍由一个评价小组负责,以保持跨机构时间分配。

In this original cohort, post-submission verification evaluates mathematical validity with extended compilation where needed. Acceptance requires the unchanged submitted artifact to satisfy the task statement, fixed-context checks, and permitted proof dependencies. Scores use these verified outcomes, and reference improvements are distinguished from matching the reference within the stated numerical tolerance.

blocks.en: The eight Full agents attempt all 30 conjectures; the nine Lite agents have results on the selected five, with the repetitions in Table 9 . blocks.en: Table 17 separates producing valid optimization outputs from meeting a certificate-based target. For each optimization attempt, we compute the fraction of judged instances with accepted feasible solutions, then average attempts within tasks and tasks equally. An attempt contributes to the full-set count only if every instance has a valid result. Across the 27 optimization tasks, Astra’s mean validity is 99.3%, compared with 93.9–97.5% for the other agents in Table 17 ; it returns valid solutions on every instance in 24 tasks. The three certificate-based tasks instead require the designated correctness or target certificate; their binary completion rates are reported separately. These statistics describe reliability across the instances of each problem, while objective values measure solution quality.

blocks.en: The Kimi K3-relative comparison uses a common set of 1,838 judged instances for every model. The excluded 32 instances lack two valid numerical Kimi K3 outcomes, which are required to estimate the sample standard deviation in Appendix B.2 . On 23 maximum-satisfiability instances, all three attempts are rejected because the output lacks the required objective-value line. Among nine sports-timetabling instances, eight have no feasible Kimi K3 solution and one has only a single feasible solution; the other submissions violate hard constraints. These are recorded unsuccessful solutions, with no missing judging records. We exclude these instances from every model’s relative score to maintain a common comparison set. Their outcomes remain in the raw records and failure counts, and the original task-score rules remain unchanged.

blocks.en: For Dijkstra, static comparison across the bare and scaffolded task versions confirms that the main statement and shared definitions agree after renaming the external interval-DAG bound and its bound variable; the scaffolded tasks additionally define the heap operations used by their checkpoints. For bidding games, the main statement and shared definitions agree, with additional helper declarations in the scaffolded tasks. The negations statements and shared definitions agree without renaming. These checks establish a common formal target for each case while retaining the differences in supplied context, prompts, and verifiers. In both selected tasks, the source verifiers award full credit to an accepted direct main proof as well as to an assembled proof. Submissions can therefore earn full credit through either proof route.

blocks.en: Figure 11 separates complete-proof acceptance from isolated checkpoint acceptance. All three Dijkstra guided submissions have accepted complete proofs. The separate complete-proof check preserves full credit for this submission. Bidding’s second ladder attempt passes two checkpoints and receives a score of 25.0%, without an accepted complete proof. Its third ladder attempt passes all intermediate checkpoints but leaves the main-theorem checkpoint unproved. These distinctions separate completion of the target theorem from progress along the supplied proof structure.

blocks.en: The target asks for a budget-agnostic winning strategy, whose action depends on the current vertex and tie-breaking advantage rather than the exact available budget. Theorem 27 of Avni & Sadhukhan (2026) constructs this strategy by applying value iteration at a trimmed threshold budget. Its proof tracks the excess budget, which is nondecreasing and bounded, and partitions play into intervals on which this quantity stays constant. This gives the initial energy bound M = ( k + 1 ) ​ ( W + H ) M=(k+1)(W+H) , where k k is the total integer budget, W W bounds absolute edge weights, and H H is the maximum energy threshold at the threshold budgets.

blocks.en: The third ladder attempt provides a concrete comparison. Its final judge log accepts all seven intermediate checkpoints, including the value-iteration fixed point, the budget invariant, and the threshold-average property. The main theorem remains a sorry placeholder, and both complete-proof checks fail; the exact checkpoint fraction 7 / 8 7/8 corresponds to 87.5% (the historical score export rounds this to 88.0% in Table 22 ). Near the end of the 12-hour budget, the last build still reports the unfinished declaration and the final response records the target as incomplete. Thus this attempt’s partial credit comes from intermediate obligations that were accepted conditionally, while the final strategy-existence argument was not completed. Against the same formal target, the successful bare submission completes its invariant argument, while this independent ladder attempt leaves the final strategy-existence obligation open. In the second guided attempt, the model proposed the auxiliary lemma muN_kStar_le_xN , then identified a counterexample involving tie-breaking. The lemma was absent from the supplied task; the attempt exhausted its budget while revising the proof. A third guided attempt worked in auxiliary Lean files but left the designated submission unchanged, yielding no accepted checkpoints. This distinguishes unfinished mathematical obligations from failure to integrate working files into the submitted artifact.

blocks.en: Artifact validity and novelty are recorded separately. The archive retains the original output, its checksum, task version, verifier and toolchain, verification log, recomputed value or accepted statement, and evaluation resources. A record comparison additionally includes the original source, date and location, prior value, parameter restrictions, and applicable resource conditions. A floating-point difference within the declared tolerance is not counted as an improvement.

blocks.en: An extension specifies the research question and source, submission type, accepted evidence, scoring rule, and execution resources. It then follows the development checks in Appendix C : source correspondence, executable validation, negative tests, trial evaluation, and expert review. The task manifest records its field and parameter coverage so that extensions can increase both breadth and depth without changing the meaning of existing scores.

blocks.en: New problems use the corresponding output interface: a formal proof, a reusable solver, an explicit object with verified properties, or a proof or refutation of a conjecture. A task combining several methods still specifies exactly what must be submitted and what the checker establishes. This permits research workflows to vary while the evaluated output remains explicit.
blocks.zh: 新问题使用相应的输出界面:形式证明,可重复使用的解析器,具有已验证属性的显性对象,或者对猜想的证明或反驳. 一项结合几种方法的任务仍然明确规定必须提交什么和核对员确定什么。 这使得研究工作流程各不相同,而评价的产出仍然明确。

blocks.en: G.2 Versioning and corrections

blocks.en: Statements, environments, scorers, instance sets, and references remain fixed within an evaluation version. Corrections and additional tasks receive new versions with dated explanations. Reports identify which results are affected and whether re-evaluation is necessary. Source corrections can update a reference value in a later release with provenance; a model improvement is retained as an outcome rather than silently changing the comparison used for that evaluation.
blocks.zh: 声明、环境、记分器、实例集和参考文献仍固定在评价版内。 更正和额外任务收到新版本并附有日期说明。 报告确定哪些结果受到影响,是否需要重新评估。 源码校正可以更新后版的参考值并附有出处;模式改进被保留作为结果,而不是默默地改变用于该评价的比较。

blocks.en: Retired tasks remain available with their historical version and retirement reason. Comparisons across releases report the common task set or explicitly identify the changed collection. A maintained benchmark can thereby grow without rewriting earlier results.
blocks.zh: 退休任务仍然随历史版本和退休原因而存在。 各版的比较报告共同的任务设定或明确指明了已更改的收集。 因此,维持的基准可以在不改写先前的结果的情况下增长。

blocks.en: G.3 Recording research outputs
blocks.zh: G.3 记录研究成果

blocks.en: The project maintains an artifact index linking results to the statements or objects checked, their originating task versions, and verification records. Research status distinguishes reproduction, validated improvement relative to a specified reference, and a novelty claim supported by source review. Verified special cases and reductions can be indexed alongside the complete-resolution score, preserving their mathematical content without changing that score retrospectively.
blocks.zh: 该项目维持一个文物索引,将结果与所检查的报表或物品、其最初的任务版本和核查记录联系起来。 研究状况区分了复制,与特定参考相比经过验证的改进,以及经来源审查支持的新颖性索赔. 经核实的特例和减值可以与全解分值一起进行索引,保留其数学内容而无需追溯性地改变该分值.

Selected tasks retain their original scoring rules and receive equal weight within each track. The list was fixed before evaluating Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. The Index in Equation 1 is a later reporting summary, applied with the same weights to both suites.
